description: Append-only per-step attestation for one API synthesis super-step. Each step records the recipe, the upstream raw-material attestations consumed, the equipment / operator DIDs, in-process check results, and downstream intermediate produced. Per ADR-2605250515 §Decision 2 (3-compound routes) + ADR-2605250500 §Decision 3 G9 (witness N≥2).

apiInn.description: Wave 1 + Wave 1b + Wave 1c API catalog per ADR-2605250500 §Decision 2 + ADR-2605250600 §Decision 1 + ADR-2605250615 §Decision 1. Wave 1 triplet (sodium-cromoglicate, naphazoline-hydrochloride, chlorpheniramine-maleate) for sterile eye drop; Wave 1b 9 additions for oral tablet + topical; Wave 1c 7 additions (omeprazole chiral + laxatives + cough-expectorant). Future apis require G3 silen-pharma-review with 'wave-1c-*' or higher scope value.

stepIndex.description: Monotonic step within this synthesis (DSCG=1..5, naphazoline=1..3, chlorpheniramine=1..4).

recipeUri.description: AT URI of versioned recipe record.

rawMaterialAttestationUris.description: Upstream rawMaterialAttestation AT URIs consumed in this step.

priorStepUri.description: If stepIndex > 1, the previous step's apiSynthesisAttestation AT URI.

inProcessCheckResults.description: TLC Rf, UV scan, temperature profile compliance, mass balance, etc.

intermediateYieldBp.description: Step yield in basis points (1 bp = 0.01%; 10000 = 100%). Example: 7530 = 75.30% yield.

safetyIncident.description: If any safety incident during step (NaNH₂ flare, exotherm, etc.) record here; triggers Council Lv6+ if non-empty.
